findings.reason: an author who sees the census fixes all five in one pass; the section as written hands the worker a partial, reverse-engineered scope.
findings.text: census: `§5` names none of the five repairs still open (they exist only in comment `c-20260826-promotion-scope-landed`), each with a site to extend — (2) orphaned verification edge: `reckon/crew/promotion.py:8237` reads `ledger.predecessor_run_id` (`reckon/ledger.py:483`) but asserts no producer-presence refusal; (3) retroactive gate rewrite: `reckon/crew/promotion.py:1131` `_require_gate_log_agrees` freezes nothing against the producer's own done-when; (4) static-audit promotion stored `not-run`: no command-shaped `gate_check` path; (5) legacy rows lacking persisted `node_definition.write_paths`: `reckon/crew/promotion.py:5260` backfills only when a manifest file survives; (6) `failure_classification` semantic consistency: `reckon/crew/promotion.py:7258` `_IMPL_MOVE_EXEMPT_CLASSIFICATIONS` checks membership, not consistency
